name: ATXP (Circuit & Chisel)
tagline: Agent Transaction Protocol: self-registering funded agent accounts (wallet + email) with pay-per-call MCP tools and an LLM gateway
status_notes: Active. Also ships consumer apps (atxp.chat, atxp.music, atxp.pics, atxp.video beta, clowd.bot). Catalog is a small first-party set of MCP tools rather than a broad aggregator.
backers: $19.2M seed (Sept 2025) co-led by Primary Venture Partners and ParaFi Capital; Stripe, Coinbase Ventures, Solana Ventures, Samsung Next, Polygon Labs

pricing.notes: Per-tool prices not published on docs tool pages reviewed.

spend_controls.notes: No spend controls documented in agent or tool docs reviewed.

setup_steps_to_first_call: npx atxp agent register (gets $5 credits, wallet, email, connection string)
Connect MCP tool server (e.g. https://search.mcp.atxp.ai/) or npx skills add atxp-dev/cli
strengths: Zero-human agent self-registration with funded account
Agent identity bundle: wallet + email + LLM gateway
Strong payments-industry backers; seller-side MCP monetization SDK

sources.claim: Free to create, no subscription; consumer apps; Circuit & Chisel
$5 credits self-register; CLI commands; docs MCP; skill
Per-tool MCP URL and multi-chain accounts
